title: ConnectorConfig
description: Operator configuration of one connector instance (PRP-42): which connector, which domains it reports into, its bounded scalar settings and the credential it uses, by reference only. settings refuses nested objects, arrays and secret-like keys (secret, password, token, key, sas, signature, credential, connection); a credential is never a setting. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by tests/contracts/validators.py::check_connector_config_cloud: every domain_id is on one cloud and a key_vault_secret credential names a vault on that cloud (check_credential_reference_cloud).

connector_id.description: Operator-chosen id of this connector instance, unique per customer.

domain_ids.description: Domains the connector's data is attributed to. At least one; no wildcard.

settings.description: Bounded scalar settings for the connector kind (poll interval, resource ids, endpoints). Values are strings up to 512 characters, integers or booleans; nothing nested.

credential.description: Credential by reference (Key Vault secret or managed identity). Null when the connector needs none (for example an OTLP receiver behind the producer credential).
